items.exampleEn: The map shows the old streets accurately.
items.exampleZh: 這張地圖準確地畫出了舊街道。

items.exampleEn: The movie was so dull that I fell asleep.
items.exampleZh: 那部電影無聊到我睡著了。

items.exampleEn: Fixing the broken door is urgent.
items.exampleZh: 修理壞掉的門是很緊急的事。

items.exampleEn: The new manager was formally introduced at the meeting.
items.exampleZh: 新經理在會議上被正式介紹給大家。

items.exampleEn: The police made a thorough search of the area.
items.exampleZh: 警方對這一帶做了徹底的搜查。

items.exampleEn: It is unusually cold for May.
items.exampleZh: 以五月來說，天氣冷得不尋常。

items.exampleEn: The shirt has blue and white stripes.
A small knife is handy when you go camping.
items.exampleZh: 去露營時，一把小刀很好用。

items.exampleEn: He gave me an indirect answer.
items.exampleZh: 他給了我一個拐彎抹角的回答。

items.sentenceEn: The station was unusually quiet this morning.
items.sentenceZh: 今天早上車站異常安靜。

items.audioEn: Sorry, I have to leave now. There's an urgent problem at the office.
items.audioZh: 抱歉，我現在得走了，辦公室有個緊急的問題。

items.sentenceEn: Keep a notebook handy so you can write down new words.
items.sentenceZh: 把筆記本放在手邊，這樣就能隨時記下新單字。

items.sentenceEn: I like the dress with thin black stripes.
items.sentenceZh: 我喜歡那件有細黑條紋的洋裝。

items.stemEn: Please measure the room ____; the new carpet must fit perfectly.
items.stemZh: 請準確地量房間的尺寸，新地毯必須剛好合適。

items.stemEn: This knife is so ____ that it won't even cut bread.
items.stemZh: 這把刀鈍到連麵包都切不動。

items.passageEn: Last Monday was an unusually busy day at our hotel. In the morning, an urgent call came from the head office: one of its managers would visit in the afternoon. Our boss formally asked all the staff to help. We gave every room a thorough cleaning and checked every detail on the list carefully. The visitor was a quiet man in a striped shirt. He asked only indirect questions, so we all felt nervous. But in the end, he said our hotel was in excellent condition.
items.passageZh: 上星期一，我們飯店異常忙碌。早上總公司打來一通緊急電話：那裡的一位經理下午要來視察。我們老闆正式請全體員工幫忙。我們把每個房間都徹底打掃了一遍，並仔細核對清單上的每個細節。來訪的是一位穿條紋襯衫、話不多的男士。他只問一些拐彎抹角的問題，所以大家都很緊張。不過最後他說，我們飯店的狀況非常好。

questions.questionZh: 總公司打來的電話說了什麼？

options: 來訪的人問題都拐彎抹角
來訪的人比預定時間晚到

items.promptZh: 這件事很緊急，請馬上處理。
referenceEn: This is urgent, so please deal with it right away.
This matter is urgent. Please handle it immediately.
rubricZh: urgent 表示「緊急的」，可放在 be 動詞後（例如 This is urgent）
「處理」可寫 deal with、take care of、handle 等

items.promptZh: 這份報告寫得很詳盡、很清楚。
referenceEn: This report is very thorough and clear.
The report is thorough and very clear.
rubricZh: 用 thorough 表示「詳盡的」（例如 is very thorough；寫 detailed 也正確）
「寫得很…」可寫，例如 is very thorough、is written very clearly 等
